description: Official sources of the engine terrain (backend/CONTRACTS.md, section 1) and how data/scripts/fetch_terrain.py builds it. pixel_sha256 pins the pixel data (dtype, shape, then the values little-endian, row by row), not the file bytes. Run fetch_terrain.py --update-pins only after a deliberate change of source.

trn_ctx_dtm.name: Context Camera Digital Terrain Model Mosaic for Mars 2020 Terrain Relative Navigation
trn_ctx_dtm.citation: Fergason, R., Galuszka, D., Hare, T., Mayer, D., Redding, B., Smith, E., 2020-07-24, USGS Astrogeology Science Center
trn_ctx_dtm.coverage: 18.2110-18.7212 N, 77.1605-77.6990 E (about 30 x 30 km around the landing site)
trn_ctx_dtm.vertical_datum: metres above the Mars areoid (MOLA topography, delta geoid)
trn_ctx_dtm.vertical_accuracy: 3.8 m vertical registration between the CTX DTMs, after shifting the mosaic 183.3 m to align with HRSC (USGS metadata)
trn_ctx_dtm.projection: equirectangular, standard parallel 0, central meridian 0, sphere 3396190 m
trn_ctx_dtm.note: Pixel for pixel the same as NASA Mars Trek's 'MRO CTX, Jezero DEM, Controlled' (data/raw/jezero_ctx_dem_20m.tif), which the map overlays use.

trn_hirise_dtm.name: High-Resolution Imaging Science Experiment Digital Terrain Model Mosaic for Mars 2020 Terrain Relative Navigation
trn_hirise_dtm.citation: Fergason, R., Galuszka, D., Hare, T., Mayer, D., Redding, B., Smith, E., 2020-07-24, USGS Astrogeology Science Center
trn_hirise_dtm.vertical_datum: metres above the Mars areoid (MOLA topography, delta geoid); median 0.4 m below the CTX DTM mosaic (USGS metadata)
trn_hirise_dtm.projection: equirectangular, standard parallel 0, central meridian 0, sphere 3396190 m

jpl_ctx_dem.name: Mars 2020 Science Investigation CTX DEM Mosaic
jpl_ctx_dem.citation: PDS4 product urn:nasa:pds:mars2020_ctx_basemap_2021:data:m20_ctxdem_mosaic, version 1.0; its label cites Mangold et al., 2021, Perseverance rover reveals an ancient delta-lake system and flood deposits at Jezero crater, Mars, Science
jpl_ctx_dem.doi_note: The dataset has no DOI; the paper its label cites is doi:10.1126/science.abl4051.
jpl_ctx_dem.coverage: 17.5805-19.2902 N, 76.9974-78.5826 E (89 x 101 km: the whole crater and its rim)
jpl_ctx_dem.vertical_datum: not stated in its label; within 0.1 m of the TRN CTX DTM where they overlap, so the same areoid heights
jpl_ctx_dem.projection: equirectangular, standard parallel 18.4663, central meridian 0, sphere 3396190 m (resampled onto the soc_008 grid)

mola_hrsc_blend.name: Mars MGS MOLA - MEX HRSC Blended DEM Global 200m v2
mola_hrsc_blend.citation: Fergason, R.L., Hare, T.M., Laura, J., 2018, HRSC and MOLA Blended Digital Elevation Model at 200m v2, Astrogeology PDS Annex, U.S. Geological Survey
mola_hrsc_blend.doi_note: No DOI; USGS asks users to cite Fergason, Hare and Laura (2018).
mola_hrsc_blend.coverage: global, 106694 x 53347 px (11.4 GB); only the window below is read, over the network
mola_hrsc_blend.projection: degrees (0.003374121 deg pixels) on the sphere 3396190 m

window.note: about 100 km around the landing site in every direction, the box of the earlier backend/scripts/download_mola_crop.py (removed)

sources.note: The crop covers every test pose with 2 km around it, cut back to where the mosaic has data (no holes: the engine would switch through them without blending). vertical_offset_m is measured against ctx_20m.

The reference level: the other sources are shifted to it. soc_008 where it exists; around it the JPL mosaic, aligned to soc_008 and cleaned of blunders, out to the 80 x 80 km box (data/scripts/ctx_merge.py). With trn_ctx_dtm alone it is soc_008 alone.
vertical_offset_m is measured where it meets ctx_20m (within 600 m of the CTX edge, where the engine's check_terrain.py looks).
